Lūdī et lūdibria · Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

swimsuit in Latin

swimsuit

vestis balneāris

Late LatinNeo-LatinDraft
  • vestis balneāris — swimsuit; bathing clothes late Latin (Traupman 389; Lampr. Alex. Sev. 42 (Lewis & Short))
  • vestis natātōria — swimsuit modern also used (M-O 38 s.v. swimsuit)
  • subligāculum balneāre — swimsuit modern also used (Vatican lexicon) Traupman and Morgan–Owens use this phrase and its variant for swimming trunks.

See also: swimming trunks.
